268.title: Batman

But when a deformed madman known as 'The Joker' seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale.

43980.title: Bashu, the Little Stranger
43980.overview: During the Iran-Iraq War, young Bashu loses his home and family. Orphaned, he sneaks into a truck leaving the area, and gets off in the Northern country, where everything from landscape to language is different. He meets Naii, trying to raise her two young children on a farm while her husband is away. Despite cultural differences and a language barrier, Bashu and Naii slowly form a strong bond.

645708.title: Dragon
645708.overview: Set in 1967 around International Opium Trade by Afghan Trading Company and Golden Trading Company
645708.trailerName: Dragon Glimpse - Telugu | NTR | Anil Kapoor | Rukmini Vasanth | Ravi Basrur | Prashanth Neel

656908.title: Ramayana
656908.overview: An ancient epic follows a young prince and princess whose marriage and subsequent exile mark the beginning of a legendary journey. Their story of love, duty and destiny sets the stage for greater challenges ahead.

870092.title: Greta e le favole vere
870092.overview: Nine-year-old Greta loves making Christmas decorations with her babysitter, Katy. She believes so strongly in Santa Claus that she decides to deliver a letter to her neighbor, Nicola, who leads her to believe he is Santa's personal assistant. Of course, Nicola has been lying; when Greta exposes the truth, he confesses that he has no connection to Santa Claus. To make amends, Nicola—a talented illustrator—draws an animated fairy tale for her that will change her life.

950028.overview: Joe and Angela's marriage is on thin ice. When they invite their enigmatic upstairs neighbors for a dinner party, the night spirals into unexpected places. Have they reignited the spark or lit the match that burns it all down?

1004556.title: Elsewhere Starts Here and It's All Happening

1004556.original_title: Elsewhere Starts Here and It's All Happening

1101644.title: When We Get There

Along with Cal’s long-term girlfriend Ellie and a new guitar named Stevie, the trio are forced to navigate uncertain futures on a 2000-mile journey in a car on its last leg. Along the way they discover what, and who, it’s worth showing up for.
1101644.trailerName: When We Get There Movie | Official Release Trailer

1127628.title: The Thing with Feathers
1127628.overview: Following the death of his wife, a young father's hold on reality crumbles, and a strange presence begins to stalk him from the shadowy recesses of the apartment he shares with his two young sons.

1128204.title: Feed
1128204.overview: Five social media influencers spend a weekend at a forest retreat but inadvertently awaken and confront the world's first vampire.

1151244.title: Vermiglio
1151244.overview: In the last days of the Second World War, a deserting soldier disrupts a tranquil and isolated mountain community. For one family, his arrival brings excitement and romance, but tragedy lies in wait.

1214028.title: Kangaroo
1214028.overview: Ex TV personality, Chris Masterman, becomes stranded in an Outback town outside Alice Springs. There, he teams up with 12-year-old Indigenous girl Charlie. The pair form an unlikely friendship and work together to rescue and rehabilitate orphaned joeys in the remote but stunning Outback community—an endeavour that proves to be life-changing for them both.

1231052.title: KitKatClub: Kinks of Berlin
1231052.overview: The story of the legendary Berlin club and its founder, a woman whose life is inextricably interwoven with the bright and dark sides of a hedonistic lifestyle.

1257868.title: Couples Weekend
1257868.overview: What happens when a tree falls in the woods and someone does hear it? Two couples are forced to deal with such a question — and their lives in general — when a New Year's Eve trip to the woods unearths simmering feelings and the secrets they carry threaten to break their seemingly perfect relationships.

1280076.title: Four Seasons in Java
1280076.overview: Pertiwi returns to her hometown after spending two decades in prison to rebuild her life. There, she finds power in things that have been abandoned: discarded electronic devices that mysteriously light up and a community of outcasts living on the fringes of society. But coming home also means confronting the four men who sent her to prison and now rule the village. Together with the outcasts, Pertiwi begins to uncover the darkness that still haunts the place - and the past she thought she had left behind.

1353228.title: SYNC
1353228.overview: In the near future, a grieving man turns to groundbreaking technology to reunite with an AI generated version of his deceased fiancé, but as he delves deeper into their virtual encounters, he notices something is off with her programming.

1404684.title: Just an Illusion
1404684.overview: In 1985 suburban Paris, 12-year-old Vincent lives with his distant older brother and quarrelling parents. Amid laughter and unease, he navigates friendship and first love, while beginning to confront the adult world.

1441228.title: Irumudi
1441228.overview: An alcoholic with a violent past—living peacefully with his daughter beside a waterfall—decides to take Ayyappa Deeksha (a 41-day spiritual vow and period of intense austerity) at her request.

1472844.title: Everyone Is Lying to You for Money
1472844.overview: With any and all things crypto being pushed by celebrities, influencers, and politicians alike, actor-turned-author and director Ben McKenzie decides to investigate. Leveraging his celebrity status to gain access to eager prospectors, McKenzie finds himself unraveling the loosely regulated world of cryptocurrency. This skeptical but evenhanded take on the present and future of what we consider money gives a firsthand account of the chaotic financial frontier of our time.

1477836.title: Bone Keeper
1477836.overview: Six young friends investigate missing persons cases in a remote cave system, unaware they're being stalked by an ancient creature lurking in the depths.
1477836.trailerName: Bone Keeper (2026) UK Trailer - British Monster Horror coming to FrightFest Glasgow this March!

1478476.original_title: কেউ বলে বিপ্লবী, কেউ বলে ডাকাত

1484620.title: Everybody to Kenmure Street
1484620.overview: In May 2021, a UK Home Office dawn raid triggers one of the most spontaneous and successful acts of civil resistance in recent memory. In Pollokshields, Scotland’s most diverse neighbourhood, hundreds of residents rush to the streets to stop the deportation of their neighbours.

1486860.title: Haunted 3D: Echoes of the Past
1486860.overview: A man seeks refuge in a remote Indian mountain mansion, fleeing his past. He discovers the house harbors sinister secrets, pain, and terror ready to torment him.
1486860.trailerName: Haunted - Ghosts Of The Past 3D Official Teaser| Vikram Bhatt,Anand Pandit,Mimoh,Chetna Pande,21 Nov

1489036.title: Born to Fake
1489036.overview: In 1996, one of the biggest media scandals in German history shook the public: Michael Born, a self-made journalist, had faked over twenty reports for the newly established private television station between 1990 and 1996. Some seemed amateurish, others dealt with absurd topics: child labor for IKEA in India, drug addicts licking toads to get high, and the Ku Klux Klan in the Eifel region were just some of his numerous fabrications. How did it come to this? Was Michael Born an enlightened figure who subversively exposed the tabloid system, a victim of the system, or simply a bumbling fraud? Film traces Michael Born's footsteps. Put together from hundreds of hours of raw material and the memories of former companions, an incredible story of forgery emerges. A media-theoretical film about levels of reality, fake news, and the question: Why do we actually believe what we see?

1489932.title: Always Lalisa
1489932.overview: Documentary following global superstar LISA during a transformative year away from BLACKPINK, the K-pop phenomenon that made her one of the world's most recognizable performers. Documenting a year of risk, reinvention, and self-discovery as LISA begins to define her next chapter.

1491788.title: Mousey
1491788.overview: Babette unexpectedly finds herself sharing her small Parisian apartment with Edo, a Congolese refugee. When an escaped lab mouse makes itself known, their lives are turned upside down as they try to navigate conflicting expectations.

1497740.title: Luisa
1497740.overview: Luisa recently moved out of her parent's home into a residential group at a facility for people with disabilities on the outskirts of a small German town.  There she receives support in her often turbulent everyday life. Unnoticed, Luisa becomes increasingly quiet, everyday life in the residential group continues until it is unexpectedly discovered that Luisa is pregnant. She does not say how this happened and everyone knows that her boyfriend Anton is infertile. Suspicion of sexual abuse is obvious. Luisa decides to terminate the pregnancy. The police are called in and try to find out whether a crime has been committed. The investigation becomes a test of endurance for Luisa, her relationship with Anton and for all the staff at the residential facility.

1498892.title: Tumšā robeža
1498892.overview: A historical thriller about Latvia in 1939 - a year before the Russian occupation.

1504972.title: A Woman Today
1504972.overview: The life of a young woman is turned upside down after a violent assault, making her realize the fragility of her freedom.

1507724.title: Labyrinth
1507724.overview: Shiori is a typical high school student who dreams of online stardom, but struggles to capture attention. After an embarrassing video of her goes viral, she gets trapped in her smartphone and replaced by a charismatic alter ego. As the doppelganger charms the internet and devises a nefarious plot to replace mankind with brainrot, Shiori must partner with other online outcasts to stop her digital counterpart and reclaim her life in the real world.

1513996.title: Maya & Samar
1513996.overview: Set in contemporary Athens, Maya and Samar tells the story of two young women from conflicting cultures whose brief yet torrid affair endangers the life of one, while propelling the other to instant online fame.

1522380.title: Multwoh (Patay Na Patay Sa'yo)

1522380.trailerName: Multwoh (Patay Na Patay Sa 'Yo) (CinePanalo 2026) Official Trailer - Sassa Gurl, Joao Constancia

1527180.title: Hekla
1527180.overview: Hekla, a determined Chicago actress, races through auditions, breakups, and self-doubt over the course of one chaotic day, risking her heart and career to claim her voice and step fully into the artist and woman she's meant to be.

1531852.title: Hey Balwanth
1531852.overview: Expecting to inherit the family business, a young man instead finds himself running a very different enterprise while juggling love, lies, and an unexpected legacy.

1537484.title: Wake
1537484.overview: Four semi-estranged siblings who reunite for their father’s wake, only to clash with his overbearing side of the family in a tug-of-war over how to say goodbye. As oblivious guests and a death-phobic funeral director add to the chaos, they fumble into an absurd new reality – one that, maybe, just maybe, could bring them closer together.

1538316.title: Extra Time
1538316.overview: Stepbrothers Zhenya and Tyoma do not like each other, despite playing on the same hockey team and living under the same roof. Professor Maksim Muromtsev, also Tyoma's father, is working on a time machine. Finding themselves in his laboratory, the guys are accidentally transported to 1999, where they meet 12-year-old Vadim Shipachyov - a future star hockey player and Zhenya's main idol. Now the guys must have time to help Vadim believe in himself and follow his dream before they can return to the present to lead their team to victory.

1539084.title: Baba
1539084.overview: Gourab, a journalist raised in an orphanage, dreams of becoming the perfect father more than a successful reporter. But when a dangerous child trafficking racket terrorizes Kolkata, he is forced to balance his duties as a husband, father, and journalist while risking everything to protect innocent children and uncover the truth.

1539788.title: Falcons
1539788.overview: Andy is trained by his ex-hitman father to infiltrate Hell's Cartel, but when his sister is kidnapped and betrayal hits, the plan unravels, sparking the H-Game, turning child violence into global control.

1541196.title: Winnie-the-Pooh and all-all-all
1541196.overview: Twelve-year-old Artyom discovers a portal to the magical Enchanted Forest at an abandoned dacha and meets its amazing inhabitants, Winnie the Pooh and his friends. But an attempt to show off his find to his peers turns into a disaster - Artyom is laughed at, because most people see ordinary toys rather than fairy-tale characters. The magic portal disappears, leaving Pooh and his friends in the human world. 20 years later, Artyom, who has forbidden himself to dream and has sunk into routine, finds Winnie the Pooh again, and with him a chance to return the lost meaning to his life. But to do this, they all have to find Piglet, Rabbit and Owl, scattered across different corners of the country, and send them all back to their native Enchanted Forest.

1545484.title: Deathwoods
1545484.overview: A weekend of camping intended to break Scott out of his post breakup depression, quickly turns  into a weekend of bloodshed, as his friends are picked off one by one by the urban legend that haunts the  woods surrounding the small town of Old Hickory, Tennessee.

1548300.title: Devil's Game
1548300.overview: When Michael's fiancée uses a Ouija board to manipulate his grief and create terrifying events, he must uncover her web of lies and deceit before her sinister game drives him to madness.

1548556.title: I Was a Teenage Sex Pistol
1548556.overview: Experience the Pistols' rise to global infamy with an honest, insightful account of a group of malcontents, determined to change the music business and to attack hypocrisy and stale conventions in society at large. Based off the novel written by Glen Matlock, one of the founding members of the Sex Pistols who co-wrote ten of twelve iconic songs on their only studio album, NEVER MIND THE BOLLOCKS. Glen describes in detail the mindset of the UK in the early 70's and divulges a mine of information; Steve's thievery, Wally Nightingale, the search for a singer, the exploding punk scene and a bleak backdrop providing a contrast to the excitement and energy of McLaren's shop. The public will now have a chance to hear the story, not just from a member of the band, but also from a man who had his contributions exceptionally downplayed.
1548556.trailerName: I Was a Teenage Sex Pistol (2025) - Official Clip | VMI Worldwide

1550284.title: Cher
1550284.overview: Follows a vengeance-seeking forest spirit who emerges near a remote mining camp that is trespassing on sacred forestland.

1550540.title: Honey Bunny
1550540.overview: Tonina has always taken care of her family, however she never felt like they really reciprocated her with an equal amount of help and love. Believing that it's her given right, she decides to aquire the ownership rights to a small family holiday home on the island of Hvar. However, after the rest of her kin realize what she had done, tensions begin to brew and a small family gathering turns into a turf war.

1554956.title: The Incomer
1554956.overview: On an Orkney isle, siblings Isla and Sandy survive by hunting seabirds, retelling the stories of their ancestors, and defending the isle from dreaded "Incomers". Their world is upended with the arrival of an awkward council worker who has come to uproot them from their homeland.

1558796.title: Never Change!
1558796.overview: In 2008, the graduating class of North Meadows High School had their senior year cut short due to a disastrous tornado. Now in their mid-30s, they're being forced to return home and finish high school once and for all.

1559628.title: Anaconda: Blood Coil
1559628.overview: A group of friends are terrorized by an anaconda during their vacation.

1562316.title: Accept Our Sincere Apologies
1562316.overview: In a decadent Venetian hotel, general manager Eva is drawn to the mysterious Contessa. Once a sanctuary from the outside world, the hotel has become a haunting cage, and both women long to escape. A hypnotic gothic fantasy that seduces and unsettles.

1564172.title: Me and My Condemned Father
1564172.overview: In 2002, Cheng's father murdered his mother. He is both the son of the perpetrator and the beloved son of the victim. That afternoon, he met the children of two other death row inmates. The three of them talked about life, about marriage, and about their greatest fear: their fathers, and the death penalty.

1566156.title: A morte nos teus ollos
1566156.overview: In 1994 Vigo, two disgraced police officers team up to rob a local businessman. One is a suspended father on the brink, the other a volatile high-stakes gambler. As their scheme unfolds, their fragile alliance begins to crack.

1577292.title: Newfound Happiness
1577292.overview: A raw, heartfelt exploration of grief, friendship, and the complexities of moving on after loss. It follows three bandmates as one pulls away, hoping to forget the past. One pushes forward, hoping the music can heal what's broken. And one tries to keep it all together.

1588236.title: Мон
1588236.overview: A young talented musician, Alina, gets a chance to build a career abroad. However, her plans change when she learns that her grandmother, Nuria, suffers from Alzheimer's disease. Returning to her homeland of Tatarstan, Alina tries to restore her grandmother's memory and fulfill her wish—to find the "treasure" buried in her native village. The problem, however, is that the village has long been flooded.

1591052.title: Jackpot
1591052.overview: When Ghanaian cleaner Ebenezer finds a winning lottery ticket, his dream of going to university suddenly seems within reach. But when he is unable to provide identification to claim the prize, he can no longer stay under the radar and is forced to take risks.

1595852.title: Boulevard
1595852.overview: Hasley, a girl with a list of unfulfilled dreams, and Luke, a complex and vulnerable boy marked by a tragic past, find refuge on the boulevard, where they discover whether love can conquer all.

1596300.title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem
1596300.overview: A decade after his death, genre-defying filmmaker William Greaves has one last trick up his sleeve with what he considered the most important event he captured on film: a 1972 party he engineered with the living luminaries of the Harlem Renaissance.
1596300.original_title: Once Upon a Time in Harlem

1597196.title: A Common Story
1597196.overview: Erika and Mauro live in the province, living a simple life made up of reassuring habits and small gestures. When their daughter Irene leaves to study abroad, the house empties, and the balance on which the couple has built their existence seems to be shaken.

1605324.title: Flying Bee
1605324.overview: “Abeja Voladora” follows Ramona, a woman who begins working as a reporter at a major newspaper. After being sexually assaulted by her boss, she sets out to seek revenge, committing crimes that start drawing the attention of detective Benjamín Flores. As Benjamín investigates the cases, he unexpectedly begins to fall in love with Ramona, unaware that she is the one behind the violent acts.

1610380.title: Fanboy
1610380.overview: Fifteen-year-old Sem is a fan of YouTuber Wesley. When Sem accidentally films his idol's angry outburst, he uses the footage to blackmail himself into Wesley's life. His hope for a forced friendship with Wesley slowly but surely turns into something more sinister.

1612428.title: Poison
1612428.overview: Elzė returns to Lithuania from Switzerland for a vacation. She rents a cozy farmhouse in a remote village, hoping to find peace and inspiration for her painting. However, the idyllic peace is disturbed by Nojus. Their budding friendship soon sparks passion, and their love is intertwined with desire, longing, and fear. Elzė's past haunts her—she is being pursued by her ex-boyfriend. Will these two passion-driven people be able to overcome the shadows of the past and simply love each other?

1616268.title: Aroopi
1616268.overview: A vengeful Yakshini, once sealed inside a doll at the Aryanattu estate, is accidentally unleashed by two thieves. When a brutal murder draws Niranjan, the last surviving heir of the lineage, back to his ancestral home, he must confront an ancient curse and the dark secrets surrounding his family's past.
1616268.trailerName: Aroopi Official Trailer | Abhilash Warrier | Vysakh Ravi | Neha Chawla | Joy Mathew | Gopi Sundar

1617484.title: Wind Up: The Movie
1617484.overview: A pitcher who can't throw strikes and his unlikely manager form a heartfelt bond.

1618188.title: GJLS: Berapi-Api

1619020.title: Io+Te
1619020.overview: She is Mia, 36 years old, an accomplished and independent gynecologist. Averse to stable relationships, she is used to experiencing love as something to be consumed and left behind. She loves to experiment, to change, and to remain unattached. While her professional life is orderly and schematic, she seeks the exact opposite in her private life: new emotions, encounters without promises, and stories that demand no future.  He is Leo, 26 years old, a poet by nature. Averse to social media, he is in love with music and authentic things, possessing a vision of love that seems to belong to another era. Their meeting happens almost by chance in a bar, interrupting an ordinary date. From there, an overwhelming, unconventional relationship takes shape—built on passion, complicity, and shared moments.  But as is often the case, falling in love is only the beginning. When reality breaks in, bringing with it a weight of responsibilities, fears, and questions, everything changes.

1621964.title: The Swan and the Bat
1621964.overview: A kind-hearted lawyer is found stabbed to death. One man emerges as the prime suspect. With his confession the case should have been solved. But the suspect's son, Kuraki Kazuma and the victim's daughter, Shiraishi Mirei, both sense that something about their fathers' words and actions doesn't add up. When the suspect's son and the victim's daughter join forces, the very notion of the truth begins to unravel.
1621964.trailerName: 映画『白鳥とコウモリ』特別映像【9月4日(Fri.) ROADSHOW】

1626188.title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
1626188.overview: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.
1626188.original_title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter

1628812.title: BLOODLINE: HUNT OR BE HUNTED

1628812.trailerName: BLOODLINE: HUNT OR BE HUNTED | Teaser Trailer

1635276.overview: In this tumultuous comedy, five eccentric dog owners seek help in dealing with their four-legged friends. Their last hope: an intensive course with the charismatic and legendary dog trainer Nodon in the Tyrolean mountains.

1649868.overview: Part 4 of Girls und Panzer spin-off series.

1654028.title: Little Miss Fortune
1654028.overview: A young journalist must find a story in Belfast before midnight or lose his job.

1656332.overview: On the war's anniversary, a Ukrainian woman in Toronto must choose between her fiancé's family or supporting her war-displaced niece.

1657228.overview: Carole Pope shattered taboos with her raw, unapologetic music and defiant sexuality—AntiDiva is the story of a queer rock icon reclaiming her place in the spotlight.

1658572.title: Hungria: A Escolha de um Sonho

1660940.title: Nee Forever
1660940.overview: A Gen Z couple meets via dating app. Their relationship unfolds with unexpected consequences.

1663244.title: Two Pids
1663244.overview: After the world premiere of Being John Smith at the Toronto Film Festival a strange experience in the filmmaker’s hotel causes him to ponder the nature of reality.

1666700.title: Che Guevara: The Last Companions
1666700.overview: After the triumph of the Cuban Revolution in 1959, three guerrilla fighters followed Che Guevara in his attempt to carry the uprising beyond the island. In 1967, after their final battle in Bolivia and Che’s execution, these shadow warriors embarked on an extraordinary 2,400 km journey across Bolivia, pursued by 4,000 soldiers and navigating remote terrain in a bid to stay alive. Sixty years later, Che’s last surviving comrades recount this untold story of endurance and loyalty, in which individual destinies were shaped by the larger geopolitical currents of the Cold War. Blending rare archive footage, animation and exclusive interviews, the film brings a forgotten chapter of history into the present.

1668364.title: Desire
1668364.overview: Lucero’s life appears immaculate: a wealthy household, a devoted husband, and two children who embody the promise of a perfect family. Yet beneath this surface simmers a quiet dissatisfaction. When Matías, a young swimming coach hired by her husband, enters their lives, Lucero finds herself pulled into a risky and consuming relationship. As secrecy, desire, and jealousy tighten their grip, the boundaries within the family begin to collapse, placing mother and daughter in a dangerous emotional triangle that threatens to shatter everything Lucero has built.

1670284.title: Cosmicat
1670284.overview: Cosmicat reveals a long-hidden truth: cats were actually aliens sent to conquer Earth. When their planet falls into an ice age, they turn to the Blue Planet for survival. Commander Nyaro arrives in ancient Egypt and boldly demands the Pharaoh's immediate surrender. But events take an unexpected turn when humans begin to revere her as a divine figure, giving rise to the myth of Bastet, the Egyptian cat goddess.

1673868.title: Charlie vs. the Chocolate Factory

1682572.title: The Fire We Choose

1730508.title: Andy Goldsworthy in Conversation with Andrew Graham-Dixon
1730508.overview: Filmed entirely on-site at the National Galleries of Scotland during Goldsworthy's monumental 2025 retrospective, Andy Goldsworthy: 50 Years, this compelling film captures an exclusive, deeply personal dialogue between the world-renowned land artist and the acclaimed art historian, author, and broadcaster.  The documentary offers an unprecedented look behind the scenes of Goldsworthy’s largest and most ambitious indoor exhibition. Surrounded by new installations created specifically for the show, the pair explore the core environmental philosophies, fleeting natural materials, and creative ideas that have defined the artist's extraordinary half-century career.
1730508.original_title: Andy Goldsworthy in Conversation with Andrew Graham-Dixon

'Loinnir' is an Irish word which means " faint or veiled and tremulous gleam or shining; a glimmer", referring simultaneously to light reflected on the waves and the warm internal feeling which stems from quality time spent with friends.
